name: sig-node
description: runtime/CRI on the node: pod lifecycle, exec/attach, probes, security context, env, sysctls, ephemeral containers

name: sig-api-machinery
description: apiserver contract: CRDs, admission webhooks, watch, namespaces, garbage collection, resource quota, server-side apply

name: sig-storage
description: volume/mount path: emptyDir, configMap/secret/projected/downwardAPI volumes, subpaths

name: sig-apps
description: workload controllers: Deployment, ReplicaSet, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job, CronJob (rolling updates, scale, ordered bring-up)

name: sig-scheduling
description: predicates and basic scheduling: node selectors, taints/tolerations, resource fit

name: sig-auth
description: ServiceAccount tokens, projected SA volumes, related authn/authz
